_comment: NPCs, their dialog trees and shop stock (dungeon.js places/sells, panels.js shows). SCAFFOLDING: the cast, lines and stock are placeholders until the item pass. Placement: an 'N' in a room template marks the spot, else the room centre (nearest free floor). Dialog node: {text, choices:[{label, go:'node'} | {label, open:'shop'} | {label, close:true}]}. 'start' opens the first talk on a floor, 'repeat' (if present) every talk after. Stock rows point at items{}; item fx: mend | cache | refine | status (+ arg = status.json id) | null (display only). cost is per floor [F1,F2,F3]; limit = buys per player per NPC per floor; locked = shows as a sealed slot.

start.text: Ah — a live one. The rift drags all sorts down here, and most of it I sell back up. Shards only, no haggling.

repeat.text: Back again? Good. The prices haven't moved.

who.text: Vessa. I keep a stall wherever the floor stops falling apart. Ask too many questions and the stall moves.

start.text: Pilot. Three floors stand between you and the Aether Core. Rooms seal when you enter them — clear them to move on.

tips.text: Shops are marked magenta on your map. The merchant only takes shards, so pick them up. And don't stand on the red grates.

mend.name: Mending Draught
mend.desc: Restore 40% of your max HP on the spot.

cache.name: Sealed Cache
cache.desc: A locked supply cache. Drops at the merchant's feet.

refine.name: Refinement
refine.desc: Open an extra attunement pick for your build.
